messages:
Elaine: quick heads-up 1: pricing pilot v3 is ready for a limited rollout. target cutover Wed 09:00 PT. attaching cohort plan and a short ops checklist. link: https://g.co/redwood/pricing-pilot-v3
Sam: thanks. what's the experiment split and the primary guardrail?
Elaine: split = 25% control / 75% variant. guardrails = no invoice line changes for committed deals, and <4% revenue delta vs control week 1.
Raj: billing ask: need the cohort mapped to billing_account_id and the reconciliation key by EOD Tue. also need a metering compare job to produce invoice_delta.
Nina: support will add an opt-out form and a ticket tag `pricing_pilot_exempt`. do we want self-serve opt-out or support-processed only?
Tom: ops prefers support-processed for the first week so we can audit changes. we can enable self-serve after validation.
Sam: communications: growth will send an email + in-app banner to variant customers only. need final copy Tue 10:00 PT. @Elaine can you own the recipient list?
Elaine: yes. I uploaded pricing_pilot_cohort.csv to the doc. billing-bot: File uploaded: pricing_pilot_cohort.csv (Elaine) :file_folder:
Raj: sample reconciliation query i'll run after cutover:
```
-- reconciliation sample
SELECT acct, period, old_units, new_units, (new_units-old_units) AS token_delta, old_amount, new_amount, new_amount-old_amount AS amount_delta
FROM billing_view
WHERE period = '2026-06'
```
Tom: ops checklist: 1) freeze cohort 5pm Tue, 2) run canary (50 accounts across buckets), 3) stage banner, 4) run reconciliation job T+1hr, 5) rollback toggle ready. I'll publish runbook in #release-war-room.
Nina: Legal wants explicit grandfather wording: "Committed contracts signed before 2025-09-01 are unaffected until 2027-01-01." I'll draft a short amendment and share.
Elaine: propose we add an exceptions review for top 20 revenue customers; Sam can you confirm if any are on negotiated per-token addenda?
Sam: two on negotiated addenda; i'll DM details. they should be auto-grandfathered unless they opt in.
Raj: blocker: consolidated billing customers sometimes produce parent-level invoices. i'll need the parent->sub mapping to ensure we don't partially change a bill. i'll DM CSV.
Elaine: decision log: grandfather cutoff = contracts signed before 2025-09-01 until 2027-01-01; experiment split 25/75; canary = 50 accounts (L/M/H mix). final cohort freeze Tue 17:00 PT.
Tom: noted. i'll coordinate canary and report invoice shapes within 90 minutes of cutover.
Elaine: please drop final exceptions into the sheet. locking cohort at 5pm Tue. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
